title: Escaping Jakku
description: Pursuing BB-8, the First Order launched a TIE fighter attack on Jakku's Niima Outpost. Rey, Finn, and the rattled Droid searched desperately for a means of escape, and finally found a serviceable craft among various junked starships. They instantly took-off in the weathered ship, with Rey manning the controls, and Finn at the guns. After a peril-laden pursuit across the desert planet, Finn blasted his First Order oppressors, while Rey zoomed into space.
section: Star Wars: The Force Awakens #5 of 20
